name: 33411 · Royal Plm Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33411 (Royal Plm Bch) has 254 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33411 (Royal Plm Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33411 (Royal Plm Bch) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
